title: Player statistics
intro: Appearances, goals, assists and penalty minutes across all seasons. Counted is what was played for the respective club's teams; joint teams are not included. Column headers sort the table, the name leads to the player history.
loadError: The player statistics could not be loaded.
empty: No figures are available for this view. The ranking is not built from the games themselves but from a nightly aggregate: either no games have finished yet, or this view has not been computed.
emptyFiltered: No entries match this selection. Reset the filters or widen them.
exportError: The export could not be created.
exportTruncated: The file stops at 50,000 rows. Narrow the selection further, e.g. to one season or one club, to get the rest.

filters.currentMembersHint: The checkbox shows only people whose current home club is within the view. Without it, former players appear as well, with the games they played back then. The switch changes the selection, never the numbers.
